error.invalid_prefix: Enter the clock's MQTT prefix, without spaces, `#` or `+`.

user.title: Add an AWTRIX clock
user.description: Apps are added to the clock afterwards, with the **Add app** button.

data_description.prefix: The prefix set in the clock's MQTT settings, for example `awtrix_1f1b94`.

error.app_name_exists: This clock already has an app with this name.
error.color_required: Pick the color to use above this threshold.
error.invalid_template: The template could not be rendered: {error}
error.invalid_pages: The template must render a JSON object (one page) or a list of objects (several pages): {error}

user.title: Add an app
user.description: How do you want to describe the app?

menu_options.simple: Simple: one entity, an icon and colors
menu_options.template: Template: full control over the AWTRIX JSON, several pages

menu_options.convert: Convert to template mode (to go further)

simple.title: Simple app
simple.description: Shows the state of an entity, with an optional label, icon and colors. The app leaves the rotation while the entity is unavailable.

data_description.app_name: Name of the app on the clock. It cannot be changed later.
data_description.label: Text shown before the value, for example `CO2`.
data_description.icon: LaMetric icon ID (for example `2422`) or name of an icon file stored on the clock.
data_description.decimals: Leave empty to show the value as is.
data_description.threshold_1: Optional. Above this value, the text takes the first threshold's color.
data_description.threshold_2: Optional. Above this value, the text takes the second threshold's color.

template.title: App template
template.description: The template renders the app's JSON, exactly as AWTRIX expects it. Render a list of objects to get several pages that alternate.

data.cycle_only_on_screen: Alternate pages only while on screen

data_description.app_name: Name of the app on the clock. It cannot be changed later.
data_description.template: Jinja template rendering a JSON object or a list of JSON objects.
data_description.page_interval: How long each page stays on screen when the app has several pages.
data_description.cycle_only_on_screen: Publish only the first page while another app is displayed. Saves most of the MQTT traffic.
data_description.hide_when_empty: Remove the app from the rotation while the template renders no page.
data_description.lifetime: If set, the clock removes the app when Home Assistant stops refreshing it (for example while Home Assistant is down). 0 to disable.

error.invalid_template: The template could not be rendered: {error}
error.invalid_pages: The template must render a JSON object, or an empty object to turn the indicator off: {error}

user.title: Add an indicator
user.description: Indicators are the colored pixels on the right edge of the screen. How do you want to drive this one?

menu_options.simple: Simple: lit while an entity is in a given state
menu_options.template: Template: color computed by a template

menu_options.convert: Convert to template mode (to go further)

simple.title: Simple indicator
simple.description: The indicator lights up while the entity is in the chosen state, and turns off otherwise.

data_description.effect_interval: Duration of one blink or fade cycle.

template.title: Indicator template
template.description: The template renders the indicator's JSON: `color` (a hex string or an RGB list), optionally `blink` or `fade` in milliseconds. Render `{}` to turn it off.

data_description.template: Jinja template rendering a JSON object.

refresh.name: Refresh
refresh.description: Publishes every app again, for example after changing the clock's settings.
